filter.description: Filter as Field,op,value, joined with ; -- ops eq, neq, cs, sw, ew, lt, le, ge, gt, bt (values joined with |); OR between alternatives. Dates MM-DD-YYYY.

customview.description: Name of a saved custom view to read instead of filtering.

output.description: Purchase Orders with TotalRecords and CurrentPage.

create_purchase_order.title: Create a purchase order
create_purchase_order.description: Add a purchase order to Agiliron from a wrapper document.

data.description: The purchase order document in Agiliron's wrapper format, with the record inside the resource's container object.

output.description: Agiliron's MCM response with the new record's id.

update_purchase_order.title: Update a purchase order
update_purchase_order.description: Update a purchase order, identified by its unique key in the document. Every writable field must be sent; omitted ones are set to NULL.

data.description: The purchase order document in Agiliron's wrapper format, with the record inside the resource's container object.

delete_purchase_orders.title: Delete purchase orders
delete_purchase_orders.description: Delete every purchase order matching a filter, e.g. OrderNo,eq,1596. Be precise: all matches are removed.

filter.description: Filter as Field,op,value, joined with ; -- ops eq, neq, cs, sw, ew, lt, le, ge, gt, bt (values joined with |); OR between alternatives. Dates MM-DD-YYYY.
